note: Recorded by scripts/discovery-retrieval-regression.py --record. Rank movement against this file is reported, never failed on; only the SC-002 and SC-003 thresholds fail a run.

SC-002.statement: A request phrased in a different language or script from a Meal's description returns that Meal in the top five results in at least 95% of tested cases.

SC-003.statement: For requests that something on offer genuinely answers, a relevant Meal appears in the top five in at least 80% of tested cases.
